modern: What is my ruling faculty to me now? And what kind of thing am I now making it? And for what purpose am I now using it? Is it empty of understanding? Is it loosened and torn away from social life? Is it melted into and mixed with the poor flesh so as to move together with it?

explained.summary: A set of questions for checking on your own mind. What is it doing for me right now? What am I turning it into, and what am I using it for? Is it empty of good sense? Has it cut itself off from other people? Has it become so tangled up with the body that it just goes wherever the body’s wants take it?
explained.today: A useful check during a long day of screens: is my attention going somewhere I chose, or has it been carried off by hunger, tiredness and the next notification?
